reply_text:
I told Dana in a thread reply in #north-team that the settled figure is 261 seats for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal.

That number comes only from Ilse's Oct 14 message in #north-team. Nobody has corrected it since, but I couldn't find a renewal document or amendment to back it up. The last count before that was 185 seats, under Amendment No. 1 in Aug 2025. I suggested Dana check with Ilse or June if the tracker needs a signed source.
